name: Rochester Regional Health
employee_basis: Employer April 27, 2026 announcement says nearly 20,000 team members; rounded estimate, not an exact census.

go_live.description: Deloitte confirms initial Rochester General Health Workday deployment in April 2014 and the Unity transition in early 2015 after the merger. These phases must not be conflated with a new whole-group launch. Exact days and later Finance/Peakon launch dates unavailable.

evidence.reason: April 2026 employer announcement confirms current CPO and nearly 20,000 workforce.
Named SVP owns workforce technology and discusses HRIS, analytics, compliance and employee engagement.
Current public professional profile provides a relevant technology leader; his recent post says he is heading to Workday Rising, but no team mutual or buying intent confirmed.
Employer confirms Equifax The Work Number adoption for automated employment/income verification; adjacent HR automation use, not verified new testing procurement.
Company quick facts report $3.2bn operating revenue, but figure is undated and does not establish profitability or available software budget.
Implementation partner explicitly confirms April 2014 initial deployment and early-2015 Unity transition.

why_now: Expanded Workday analytics, employee listening and Finance/Supply Chain integrations make change assurance relevant to clinical workforce compliance and retention. Jason Frank's public Rising participation and integration leadership hiring suggest an accessible conversation topic; an immediate procurement deadline is unconfirmed.
persona: Integrated workforce technology / HRIS leader, with CPO sponsor
gaps: Exact initial and later module go-live days unavailable.
No verified direct buyer work email or phone, mutual introduction or willingness to purchase.
No confirmed external Workday test-automation purchase or new purchasing timeline.
Current consolidated profitability/financial stability not established from available quick facts.
research_notes: Do not confuse RRH with University of Rochester/URMC or City of Rochester; those Workday projects and launch dates are separate. A public recruiter email reposted by Jason is for benefits-job referrals, not his direct buyer email. Current first-person post states Rising attendance, but accessible relative age does not independently establish the year; avoid asserting 2026 without dated confirmation. No scores changed.
